name: Executive Dashboard
title: Executive Sales Dashboard
description: Revenue, orders, customers and margin at a glance, with the trend by month and the split by region, category, country and segment.

parameters.name: year
parameters.label: Year
parameters.optionsSql: SELECT DISTINCT year FROM sales ORDER BY 1 DESC

datasets.name: kpi
datasets.sql: SELECT round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders, count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers, round(sum(revenue) / count(DISTINCT order_id)) AS avg_order, round(100.0 * (sum(revenue) - sum(cost)) / sum(revenue), 1) AS margin FROM sales WHERE year = :year

datasets.name: monthly
datasets.sql: SELECT month, round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue, round(sum(revenue) - sum(cost)) AS profit FROM sales WHERE year = :year GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

datasets.name: regions
datasets.sql: SELECT region, round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE year = :year GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC

datasets.name: categories
datasets.sql: SELECT category, round(sum(cost)) AS cost, round(sum(revenue) - sum(cost)) AS profit FROM sales WHERE year = :year GROUP BY category ORDER BY sum(revenue) DESC

datasets.name: countries
datasets.sql: SELECT country, round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE year = :year GROUP BY country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: segments
datasets.sql: SELECT segment, round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE year = :year GROUP BY segment ORDER BY revenue DESC
